note: Indoor casualty rates and collapse fractions are the Hazus 6.1 values (Tables 12-3 to 12-8), read from the manual. They describe US building stock; mapping Indian types to C3L/C3M/URML is a judgement, outdoor casualties are not modelled, and the occupancy shares are only partly from Hazus (priors/occupancy.csv).

collapse_fraction_given_complete.source: Hazus 6.1 Table 12-8, probability of collapse given complete damage: URML 15%, C3L 15%, C3M 13%.

pager_india.source: Jaiswal, Wald & Hearne (2009), USGS Open-File Report 2009-1136, country table (India: theta 11.53, beta 0.14, alpha 1.93, 28 events): fatality rate = Phi(ln(MMI/theta)/beta). Checked against the report's text (1 death per ~25 exposed at MMI IX, ~1 per 5250 at VII). An earlier draft of this file used 14.05/0.185, which are Indonesia's values in the same table.
